Infer gene-level rhythmic parameters

Source: R/infer_gene_param.R
infer_gene_param.Rd

Fits an unrestricted zero-inflated negative-binomial harmonic model within each metadata stratum using fixed cell phase and rhythmic probability. Time-resolved expression eligibility precedes testing, and empirical-Bayes shrinkage provides stabilized harmonic effect-size estimates.

Usage

infer_gene_param(
  count,
  metadata,
  theta_pred,
  r_cell,
  strata_by,
  ZT_by,
  B = 100,
  n_worker = NULL,
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = TRUE,
  sample_by = NULL,
  sample_boot_by = NULL
)

Arguments

count

Gene-by-cell raw count matrix with gene and cell names.

metadata

Data frame containing cell-level metadata.

theta_pred

Numeric vector of inferred cell phases in radians.

r_cell

Numeric vector of cell-level posterior rhythmic probabilities.

strata_by

Metadata column defining gene-level fitting strata.

ZT_by

Metadata column defining zeitgeber-time or experimental-time bins.

B

Number of bootstrap iterations for confidence intervals. Cells are resampled in cell-level mode; whole biological samples are resampled when sample_by is supplied.

n_worker

Number of parallel workers; NULL uses available cores.

setseed

Random seed.

Verbose

Logical; whether to print progress messages.

sample_by

Optional metadata column identifying independent biological samples.

sample_boot_by

Optional metadata column stratifying sample-aware bootstrap resampling.

Value

A list containing main result tables param_long and param_wide, bootstrap_res, eligibility records for all input genes, fit diagnostics, and stratum-level shrinkage metadata.

Details

Within each fitting stratum, genes are eligible when their maximum time-bin pseudobulk relative UMI exceeds 1e-5; only eligible genes are tested and bootstrapped. P values and BH FDR are calculated from the unrestricted fit. Empirical-Bayes shrinkage stabilizes amplitude but does not alter significance testing.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data("srb_example_data")

res_phase <- infer_cell_phase(
  count = srb_example_data$Count,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  ZT_by = "ZT",
  strata_by = "celltype",
  Species = "mouse",
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

cell_use <- srb_example_data$meta$celltype == "1"

res_param <- infer_gene_param(
  count = srb_example_data$Count[, cell_use, drop = FALSE],
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta[cell_use, , drop = FALSE],
  theta_pred = res_phase$theta_pred[cell_use],
  r_cell = res_phase$r_cell[cell_use],
  strata_by = "condition",
  ZT_by = "ZT",
  B = 5,
  n_worker = 1,
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

head(res_param$param_long)
head(res_param$param_wide)
} # }
